title: Mountaineer Power Plant
scope: Mountaineer Power Plant’s above-ground skyline in the cleared Qualla view, with the two tall concrete chimneys, single hyperbolic cooling tower and mapped generating hall complex.
limitations: The chimney and tower heights come from public agency records. Secondary elevations and the external details of the hall and cooling tower are approximated from the public footprint and records.
Scope covers the principal visible structures and immediate annexes. Plant interiors, broader utility infrastructure and offsite facilities lie outside this exterior model.
